comment_regular: Verified singleton ExtraData_Seed behavior: signed byte 0xFF removes the extra; other bytes add or replace it. Combined with TESObjectTREE_GetIndexForSeed, this means an empty/missing tree seed entry cannot be persisted as a concrete per-reference seed.
